{{Quote|Oss Wilum told me you chose this world because the dark side is strong here." <br /> "Yes. There was a great darkness here.|Nomi Sunrider and Thon discuss the aftermath of Ambria's devastation|<ref name="Audio">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
At some point before the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]],<ref name="GHSW" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] was '''devastated''' due to the machinations of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Unidentified Sith sorceress|disciple]].<ref name="TOTJ" /> The [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world of Ambria<ref name="POTJ" />—harboring valuable ores along with numerous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TOTJ" />—had become the new domain of this disciple,<ref name="POTJ" /> a [[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceress]] who [[Darksider|practiced]] the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. In this time, Ambria's natural resources were gradually depleted at the behest of the sorceress, who [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the indigenous inhabitants and exploited the wildlife as beasts of burden. For [[Standard century/Legends|hundreds]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="TOTJ" /> the sorceress oversaw the construction of a gigantic [[Ambria Sith obelisk|obelisk]] in the north central regions of the planet.<ref name="POTJ" />

Upon completing the [[obelisk]],<ref name="POTJ" /> the sorceress attempted to bind the entire world of Ambria to her will through a complicated Sith [[Force power/Legends|ritual]].<ref name="DOE" /> In doing so, the disciple called upon a level of dark side power surpassing the efforts of any individual before her.<ref name="TOTJ" /> The sorceress was killed,<ref name="DOE" /> however, after losing control of this power, resulting in a wave of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy that destroyed all other living beings on the planet. In addition, Ambria itself was devastated by the energy that was unleashed upon its surface, warping the landscape and infusing it with the dark side of the Force.<ref name="POTJ" />
